name: Bloom Energy

eyebrow.en: Bloom Energy Corporation · Class A · San Jose, California
eyebrow.zh: Bloom Energy · A类股 · 加州圣何塞

title.zh: 为 AI 供电，现场发电。

lede.en: Bloom's solid oxide fuel cells let data centers make their own power instead of waiting years for a grid connection. Revenue hit $1.07B last quarter, up 166%, and 2026 guidance was raised twice to $3.9–4.2B. Oracle, AEP and all major US hyperscalers are customers or have validated the product.
lede.zh: Bloom 的固体氧化物燃料电池让数据中心自行发电，无需等待多年接入电网。上季营收增 166% 至 10.7 亿美元，2026 年指引两度上调至 39–42 亿。甲骨文、AEP 及所有美国主要云厂商均为客户或已完成验证。

s.zh: 营收约为 2025 年两倍 · 营业利润 8–9 亿
2026 第三季 · 日期未公布

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. The stock ranged from about $76 to $351 over the past year, with a beta near 3.8.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。过去一年股价在约 $76 至 $351 间，贝塔值近 3.8。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with GAAP gross margin on the right axis. Bloom's revenue is lumpy and Q4-heavy because it is booked as systems are installed. The last bar is about half of the second-half revenue implied by the full-year guide.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为 GAAP 毛利率。Bloom 按系统安装确认收入，因此季度波动大、第四季偏高。最后一根柱约为全年指引所隐含下半年营收的一半。

s.zh: 同比 +166% · 首个 10 亿季度

s.en: end-2025; $8B+ product orders added in H1
s.zh: 2025 年底；上半年新增产品订单逾 80 亿

p.en: Oracle went from a 100 MW pilot to a 2.8 GW plan and AEP from 100 MW to 900 MW. First-half product orders of over $8B fill capacity into 2028.
p.zh: 甲骨文从 100 兆瓦试点扩至 2.8 吉瓦计划，AEP 从 100 兆瓦增至 900 兆瓦。上半年逾 80 亿美元产品订单已排产至 2028 年。

p.en: Operating income rose to $240M in Q2; full-year non-GAAP operating income is guided at $800–900M.
p.zh: 第二季营业利润升至 2.4 亿美元；全年非GAAP营业利润指引 8–9 亿。

p.en: Cash flow swings with installation timing: −$220M of free cash flow in Q2 2025, +$395M in Q4 2025.
p.zh: 现金流随安装进度大幅波动：2025 年第二季自由现金流 −2.2 亿美元，第四季 +3.95 亿。

p.en: About 104× this year's guided earnings with a beta near 3.8; delays at customer sites can move quarters.
p.zh: 约为今年指引盈利的 104 倍，贝塔值近 3.8；客户现场延误会影响季度业绩。

p.en: Date not yet announced; last year's Q3 came on Oct 28.
p.zh: 日期未公布；去年第三季于10月28日发布。
指引：营收 39–42 亿美元，非GAAP每股 $2.55–2.85。

h.zh: 第四季及 FY26 业绩

sources: Price, market cap and beta: Financial Modeling Prep, as of Oct 9, 2026

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Oct 9, 2026. For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Bloom Energy Corporation.
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年10月9日。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 Bloom Energy Corporation 无关联。

guide: Sep 2026 · ~half of H2 implied by guide
2026年9月 · 约为指引隐含下半年的一半

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from Q3 2021 to Q2 2026. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 2021 年第三季至 2026 年第二季共 20 个季度。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

read.en: Bloom's cash flow follows its install schedule: it usually burns cash in the first half and collects in the fourth quarter. Over these five years it mostly burned cash, but the last four quarters were all positive, about $625M in total, as volumes doubled.
read.zh: Bloom 的现金流随安装进度变化：通常上半年烧钱、第四季回款。过去五年大多在烧钱，但随出货量翻倍，近四个季度全部为正，合计约 6.25 亿美元。

read.en: Guidance implies about $2.23B of revenue in the second half. I assume the usual seasonal pattern with a strong Q4, giving roughly $620M of free cash flow over four quarters. Capex stays small because Bloom adds factory capacity in modest 'copy exact' steps.
read.zh: 指引隐含下半年营收约 22.3 亿美元。我按惯常季节性（第四季强）估计四季自由现金流约 6.2 亿美元。由于 Bloom 以小步"复制扩产"方式增加产能，资本开支维持较低。

p.en: Building systems ahead of installs ties up cash, especially in the first half.
p.zh: 安装前生产系统会占用现金，上半年尤甚。

p.en: Capex rose to $52M in Q2, still small next to revenue.
p.zh: 第二季资本开支升至 5200 万美元，相对营收仍小。

p.en: Product revenue of $935M in Q2, up 215%.
p.zh: 第二季产品收入 9.35 亿美元，增 215%。

p.en: Bloom raised $2.5B in Q4 2025 and repaid about $0.98B of older debt.
p.zh: 2025 年第四季发行 25 亿美元，并偿还约 9.8 亿旧债。

extraNote.en: EPS is not shown in the revenue table because quarterly diluted EPS was not available from the data source.
extraNote.zh: 营收表未显示每股收益，因数据源未提供季度摊薄每股收益。
